newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian official reserves fell in October.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian official reserves fell in October.

text.p: Australia's holdings of gold and foreign exchange assets fell to US$16.272 billion in October from US$17.370 billion in September, compared with US$14.126 billion in October 1995, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
In Australian dollar terms, reserves fell by A$1.4 billion to A$20.549 billion in October from A$21.920 billion in September, compared with A$18.671 billion a year ago, the bank said.
The bank said holdings of official reserve assets fell in October mainly due to swap transactions.
